title: Abstention Errors and Segment Support in CUAD: An Auditable Contract-Extraction Case Study
abstract: arXiv:2609.13274v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Contract-clause extraction benchmarks measure reference recovery, but interpreting a system for review assistance also requires measuring unnecessary output and the evidence available within categories. This paper presents a retrospective, reproducible evaluation of a fixed public RoBERTa checkpoint on CUAD's published 102-contract test split. Candidate generation is preserved from an earlier frozen run; matching errors are corrected and category thresholds are reselected on 62 training-split contracts using the original 90% recall target. The corrected operating point recovers 82.2% of reference spans at 8.2% CUAD precision. Of 30,464 returned candidate strings, 19,562 occur on questions with no annotated answer. translated_title: CUAD中的弃答错误与片段支持：一项可审计的合同条款提取案例研究
translated_abstract: 合同条款提取基准用于衡量对参考答案的召回情况，但要解释一个用于审查辅助的系统，还需要衡量不必要的输出以及各类别内可获得的证据。本文对一个固定的公开RoBERTa检查点在CUAD已发布的102份合同测试划分上进行了回顾性、可复现的评估。候选生成保留自早先的冻结运行；匹配错误得到纠正，并在62份训练划分合同上按照原始的90%召回率目标重新选择了类别阈值。修正后的工作点以8.2%的CUAD精确率恢复了82.2%的参考文本跨度。在返回的30,464个候选字符串中，有19,562个出现在没有标注答案的问题上。该系统对2,938个此类问题中的1,335个给出了回答，误报率为45.4%（95%合同自助法置信区间：43.3–47.9%）。匹配的候选字符串占返回字符串的20.3%，这说明了为什么基于参考的精确率……
tldr: 本文对CUAD数据集上的RoBERTa合同条款提取系统进行了可复现的回顾性评估，发现其在82.2%召回率下对无标注答案问题的误报率高达45.4%，强调了对审查辅助系统衡量不必要输出（弃答错误）的重要性。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a reproducible retrospective evaluation of a RoBERTa contract-extraction system on CUAD, revealing a 45.4% false-positive rate on questions without annotated answers at 82.2% recall, and highlighting the importance of measuring unnecessary output (abstention errors) for review-assistance systems.
